Solutions by Scenario

Conference Rooms

Connect, Communicate, Collaborate.

Solution overview

Audio and video conferencing has become an everyday necessity for corporate workspaces. However, complicated equipment connections and unexpected issues during meetings can severely impact communication efficiency. To avoid these issues, our video conferencing solutions provide easy-to-use, efficient, and reliable collaboration tools for modern workspaces.

Small and Medium-sized conferencing

Challenges

Meeting rooms are frequently affected by complicated wiring, poor microphone pickup, and clumsy screen sharing setups, which cause delays and frustration for meeting participants.

Cable Clutter & Complex Wiring

HDMI, VGA, USB, and 3.5mm audio cords tangled across the meeting table confuse users and waste 10–15 minutes at the beginning of each session.

Distant Audio & Background Noise

Standard laptop mics create reverberation, hollow voice pickup, and capture keyboard clicking, leaving remote participants struggling to understand speakers.

Clumsy Screen Sharing

Complicated wireless dongles requiring software drivers, network permissions, or OS compatibility checks disrupt multi-user collaborative brainstorming.
